Title: Node Topology — Machines A and B
Content: Machine A (local laptop): runs Orchestrator.Mcp (port 5100), SplitBrain.Dashboard, and the Copilot node (Node C). GPU: RTX 5060. Default model: qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct-q4_K_M via Ollama. Machine B (inference tower): runs Orchestrator.NodeWorker (port 5050). GPU: GTX 1080 8 GB (Pascal sm_61). Default model: qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct-q5_K_M via Ollama; fallback deepseek-coder:6.7b-instruct-q4_K_M. Set NODE_B_BACKEND=llamacpp to switch Node B to llama.cpp server (port 8080) enabling MoE models like qwen3-coder-30b-a3b. Node C: GitHub Copilot SDK via CopilotClientOptions (optional). Fallback chains configurable per node in routing.json.
